title: Black Bread Tithe
description: Wolfpine's bread has turned black, gritty, and thin. Villagers blame the miller, but the marked grain sacks and guard seals suggest the hunger has been counted before it reached the oven.

not_started.summary: The party has not investigated Wolfpine's spoiled bread.

accepted.summary: The party heard complaints about black bread in Wolfpine's market.

checked_market.summary: The party inspected the market stall and found ash-thinned loaves beside underweight grain sacks.

found_guard_tithe.summary: The party found guard tithe marks on sacks that should have gone to the village ovens.

exposed_guard.summary: The party exposed the guard's extra grain tithe.

brokered_ration.summary: The party pushed Wolfpine toward a ration compromise instead of a public accusation.

resolved.summary: The black bread dispute has been resolved.
